facts.fact: The GSMA study says the government has set out a digital strategy for the next three years, in line with the Government Action Programme 2021-2026; no adopting act is named, and the document is dated January 2025 (the supporting budget presentation is November 2023).
facts.system: Government's digital strategy over the next 3 years

facts.fact: The study says the digital strategy is overseen by the Ministry of Digital Economy and implemented through ARCEP and the Agency for Information Systems and Digital Technology (ASIN); it gives no date, so its published date of January 2025 applies.
facts.system: Government's digital strategy over the next 3 years

facts.fact: The Minister for Digitalisation's budget presentation to the National Assembly's budget committee in November 2023 said CFA 12.79 billion would be used for digital transformation projects, which the study lists among the strategy's priorities.
facts.system: Government's digital strategy over the next 3 years

facts.fact: The study says the World Bank support programme of the Government Action Programme and the digital strategy, with digitalisation of public service delivery as a key priority, is a USD 150 million funded programme with targets to December 2028 (World Bank report of August 2024).
facts.system: Government's digital strategy over the next 3 years
